findings.summary: The blind keyboard driver climbed to 5170/9000 (57% of the win target; the boss gate at 85% = 7650 was never reached) before all 3 shields fell at t=77.6 — the tap-only driver (2.2s strafe period, 0.3s fire taps, never holds a key) cannot dodge telegraphed bullets or hold position, so the win path is out of the rig's reach and the honest 'TRY AGAIN' loss is recorded (win:false).

The shooter's debug global is never exposed to the rig: window.__shooter is gated on ?debugShooter=1 (shooter.js:1152) but the generic rig only appends debug=1 to the boot URL, so all 108 trace rows lack the state probe entirely and win-path progress had to be read off the HUD score in the loss still (5170/9000).

Beats tiles never render for the shooter: the rig expects #beats img for this genre (?beats=1 is in the boot URL and shooter is listed in GENRE_BEATS) but shooter.js never creates the #beats DOM strip — its only 'beats' references are the boss-explosion counter — unlike nano-cure.js:207, space-mission.js:199 and rewind.js:334 which do; the beats count is 0 across all 108 trace rows and beats.ok=false.

Driver edge phase never ran here either: pause (Escape), blur, refocus and mash are scheduled at 70–90% of the 240s budget (t≥168s) but the run ended at t=77.6 on the loss overlay — all trace rows show pause:false, so pause/blur/refocus behavior, mash robustness and the audio toggles were never exercised for L04.

Booth-distance legibility is mixed: the cyan '5170/9000' HUD and the white level title read clearly, but the author line ('Fabric Team (@fabric)', 11px var(--dim), index.html:37) and the bottom instructions bar ('← → ↑ ↓ move (WASD too) · hold SPACE to fire · catch power-up orbs', dim gray) sit low-contrast on the dark backdrop, and the controls string is English-only (meta.controls, line 25; no FR variant).

Raw video evidence was lost after the run: /tmp/playtest-raw/L04-1790059659.webm is now 470 bytes and unreadable (ffmpeg/ffprobe EBML 'End of file'), although the 8 valid contact sheets (0.8–1.4MB PNGs, written 23:47) were generated from it — the live-page PNG stills and sheets remain the evidence of record.

Checklist positives verified: the cross-level heart-bank round-trips through this run (a 1-UP pickup granted a booth life, then the loss spent one — overlay '♥ lost — 3 remaining' with HUD '♥ ×3' means 4→3 since a fresh context starts at 3), and the space backdrop applies no season tint (seasonTint is not imported by shooter.js), so the AUTOMNE default has no visible effect on this level.
